title: namelengthmax
summary: Return the maximum MATLAB identifier length.

gpu_support.notes: Host language constant; no GPU kernels or provider dispatch are involved.

description: `namelengthmax` returns the maximum number of characters allowed in MATLAB identifiers. RunMat reports `2048`, matching current MATLAB behavior.
behaviors: Accepts no input arguments and returns a double scalar.
The shared identifier validator uses the same value for `isvarname`, `genvarname`, struct field-name validation, and argument-validation helpers.
Identifiers longer than `namelengthmax` are rejected by `isvarname` and repaired or truncated by compatibility helpers that generate names.

examples.description: Use the limit when validating generated names

faqs.question: Why is the value 2048 rather than 63?
faqs.answer: Older MATLAB releases used 63. Current MATLAB releases report 2048, and RunMat follows the current compatibility surface.

faqs.question: Does this run on the GPU?
faqs.answer: No. This is a language metadata constant and always returns a host scalar.
